title: Workflow-hosted reconciler has no skeleton hold-back and redispatches a review that reports done with zero commits
body: The local reconciler holds the closeout back while the review is in flight (window.go's isRoleJob check) and treats a review's empty branch as ready-to-merge (collectRole). The TypeScript port neither holds the closeout behind the review (both dispatch together in the same window) nor accepts done-with-zero-commits for a role job — such an answer is redispatched forever under a new number, each time recording another decision. Out of 9fc's scope (it belongs to the role-result/executor port, k4s), but any real review/closeout dispatch on this host will hit it.
